args.title: Ironbark Tooling newsletter: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
args.body:
- Ironbark Tooling's latest newsletter ("Cold-chain logistics in 2026") highlights that temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data.
- The linked article notes most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
- The companion piece (accessed via the newsletter's free registration link) reports that pilots cut claims by a quarter.
